TOL-BOOKING-STORE.name: SQLite booking store
TOL-BOOKING-STORE.algorithm: Execute parameterized booking reads and state transitions through a repository adapter; hydrate entities through canonical constructors and map concurrency or availability failures to the declared abstract failures.
TOL-BOOKING-STORE.transaction: Use one explicit transaction per state-changing operation and optimistic version checks for cancellation; never report success before commit confirmation.
notes: Read and write operations share one concrete protocol implementation selected at composition.
